questions.question: Two resistors, one of 20 Ω and the other of 30 Ω are connected in parallel. This combination is connected in series with an 8 Ω resistor and a 12 V battery. The current in the 30 Ω resistor is __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**0.24 A.**__

 
• 20 ohms and 30 ohms resistors are connected in parallel,

∴** Resistance in Parallel, 1/R = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂**

Resultant 1/R= 1/20 + 1/30 = 5/60 = 1/12 = 12 ohms

∴ Total resistance = 8 + 12 = 20 ohms

 
• Ohm’s Law,

⇒ **I = V/R**

⇒ I = 12/20

⇒ I = 0.6 Amp.

 
• The voltage drop across 12 ohms is 12×0.6 = 7.2 volts
 
• Current in 30 ohms resistor is 7.2/30 = **0.24 A**

questions.question: A 2,000 kg truck moving at 10 m/s strikes a car waiting at a traffic light. After the collision, the two move together at 8 m/s. The mass of the car is _____ if total energy before and after collision remain conserved.
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• The type of collision in which the total kinetic energy of the system remains constant before and after the collision is called elastic collision or perfectly elastic collision.
 
• As there is no net external force on the system, so momentum before the collision and after the collision will remain same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53f30ff565a8f800a775a33f3e7f8e7ba67f31484026846af180f2c9b88f236c.png] 

Linear Momentum before collision (P1) = Linear Momentum after the collision (P2)

P1 = m1u1 + m2u2

P2 = m1v1 + m2v2

m1u1 + m2u2 = m1v1 + m2v2

 
• The kinetic energy of the system before the collision is equal to kinetic energy of the system after the collision.

KE1 = Kinetic energy before the collision and KE2 = Kinetic energy after the collision

K{E₁} = (1)/(2){m₁}u₁² + (1)/(2){m₂}u₂² = K{E₂} = (1)/(2){m₁}v₁² + (1)/(2) {m₂}v₂²

EXPLANATION__:

Given that,

Mass of the truck (m₁) = 2000 kg

Velocity of the truck (v₁) = 10 m/s

Mass of the car = m₂

Velocity of car before collision v₂ = 0 m/s

The final velocity of car and truck after collision (Vf) = 8 m/s.

If the total kinetic energy and momentum in the system remain constant in a collision, then such collision is called Elastic collision.

By conservation of momentum i.e. final momentum is equal to initial momentum.

Initial momentum will me p₁ = m₁v₁ + m₂ v₂

⇒ (2000 × 10) + (m₂ × 0)

⇒ 20000

As initial momentum is equal to final momentum

We get p₁ = p₂

Where p₂ = (m₁ + m₂) × vf

⇒ 20000 = (2000 + m₂) × 8

⇒ 2500 = 2000 + m₂

⇒ m₂ = 500

The mass of the car is **500 kg**

questions.question: Which of the following Directive Principles was added to the PART IV of the Indian Constitution through a Constitutional Amendment Act in 1976?

options.text: To protect and improve the environment and to safeguard forest and wildlife
To separate the judiciary from the executive

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To protect and improve the environment and to safeguard forest and wildlife**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Directive Principle **“To protect and improve the environment and to safeguard forests and wildlife”** was added by the **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976**.
 
• This provision is mentioned under **Article 48A** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It directs the state to take measures for environmental protection and wildlife conservation as part of its policy objectives.
 
• The 42nd Amendment Act is often referred to as the **“Mini Constitution”** due to the extensive changes it introduced to the Indian Constitution.
 
• Article 48A emphasizes the importance of ecological balance and sustainable development in governance.

• These are non-justiciable provisions incorporated in Part IV of the Indian Constitution.
 
• They aim to establish social and economic democracy and guide the state in policymaking.
 
 
 
• **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976:**
 
 
• It introduced significant changes, including the addition of Articles 48A and 51A(g) to promote environmental protection.
 
• It also added the words “Socialist,” “Secular,” and “Integrity” to the Preamble.
 
 
 
• **Article 51A(g): Fundamental Duty:**
 
 
• It obligates every citizen to protect and improve the natural environment, including forests, lakes, rivers, and wildlife.
 
• It was also introduced by the 42nd Amendment, complementing Article 48A.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Conservation in India:**
 
 
• India has enacted various laws such as the **Environment Protection Act, 1986**, and the **Wildlife Protection Act, 1972**, to implement these constitutional provisions.
 
• Programs like **National Mission for a Green India** further align with the goals of Article 48A.

questions.question: The constitution of India was framed by a Constitution Assembly set up under the ______ of 1946.
questions.solution:

• **The Cabinet Mission came to India** to discuss the transfer of power from the British Government to the Indian leadership with a view to preserving the peace and democracy of India.
 
• The Cabinet Mission Plan was a declaration issued by the Cabinet Mission and the Viceroy, Lord Wavell, on May 16, 1946, which included recommendations on India 's constitutional future after the inability of Indian political parties and members to find an agreement.
 
• The Cabinet Mission members were: **Lord Pethick-Lawrence, President of the Board of Trade, Secretary of State for India, Sir Stafford Cripps and A.V. Alexander, First Lord of Admiralty.**
 
• **In September 1945,** the newly elected Labor Government in Britain announced its intention to set up a Constituent Assembly for India to establish the Constitution of India; the Cabinet Mission was sent to India in March 1946 to do so.
